definitions.explanation: The act of warning or disciplining oneself to avoid repeating mistakes or falling into bad habits. Reflects a deliberate effort at self-correction.

examples.japanese: {自戒|じかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I say this as a warning to myself as well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}さない→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧よう{自戒|じかい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I warned myself not to repeat the same mistake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{自戒|じかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{念|ねん}→念：12766_nen⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{刻|きざ}んでいる→刻む：03918_kizamu⟧。
examples.english: He keeps that experience engraved in his heart as a reminder to himself.

notes:
A compound of {自|じ} (self) and {戒|かい} (admonition, warning). Can be used as a noun or as a suru verb ({自戒|じかい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自戒|じかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧ (with self-admonition; including a warning to oneself)
- {自戒|じかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{念|ねん}→念：12766_nen⟧ (a sense of self-admonition)
- {自戒|じかい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to admonish oneself)

The phrase {自戒|じかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧ is commonly used when someone criticizes a behavior while acknowledging they are also guilty of it — similar to saying "speaking from my own experience" or "I need to hear this too." Note the homophone ⟦{次回|じかい}→次回：13170_jikai⟧ (next time), which is a completely different word.
